services.name: Salmon Fishing
services.desc: Fish the Tonsina River, Klutina River, Gulkana River, and Copper River with one of our top-level fishing guides. Our guided sport fishing trips target king and red salmon along with native rainbow trout, arctic grayling, and dolly varden. Full-day and half-day trips are available, and our professional guides handle river navigation, and safety, so you can focus on catching fish. Salmon Grove offers subsistence dip net transportation for Alaska residents, accessing the "above the bridge" Glennallen sub-district fishery on the Copper River.
